cards.title: Handling childhood sexual abuse disclosures in families
cards.body: Create a safe environment for victims to share their experiences at their own pace. Assess any ongoing danger the perpetrator may pose to younger family members and seek appropriate support.

cards.title: Parenting when a child leaves for university
cards.body: Empty nesting can trigger unexpected emotional responses and grief as your first child begins their independent life. Acknowledging these feelings is a normal part of the parenting journey.

cards.title: Remembering the basics with your second baby
cards.body: Second-time parents often forget essential childcare skills learned with their first child. Lean on family support and give yourself grace as you relearn feeding, teething, and sleep routines.

cards.title: Taking toddlers to music festivals
cards.body: Bringing young children to events can enrich family experiences rather than diminish them. Parents can maintain their love of music while creating meaningful memories with their kids.

cards.title: How to raise a confident, independent child
cards.body: Children develop independence through real decision-making, learning from mistakes, and solving problems on their own. Avoid over-parenting to allow authentic growth and resilience.

cards.title: Nine things emotionally attuned parents say
cards.body: Children's behavior stems from their underlying feelings rather than misbehavior alone. Using emotionally supportive language prevents trauma from passing to the next generation.

cards.title: Climate change and childhood stress in families
cards.body: Extreme heat increases family stress levels and may elevate risks of child maltreatment. Understanding environmental stressors helps parents seek support during difficult periods.

cards.title: Childhood trauma and chronic illness connections
cards.body: Painful or traumatic events in childhood can manifest as chronic pain or illness in adulthood. Trauma-informed therapy can help address these root causes.

cards.title: New psychedelic treatment for postpartum depression
cards.body: A small study shows a one-time psychedelic treatment helped all postpartum depression patients reach remission by day one. This emerging approach offers new hope for struggling parents.

cards.title: Rethinking ADHD study habits for homework
cards.body: Traditional ADHD study plans fail because they ignore the brain's need for novelty and stimulation. Restructuring homework strategies around these needs creates more productive school years.

cards.title: Toddler with sun allergy thrives with UV film
cards.body: Two-year-old Mollie Murray has a rare genetic disorder making her extremely sensitive to ultraviolet light. UV window film allows her to safely play in daylight and attend daycare.
